name: Magnifier loupe
oneLiner: a screenshot floats in a window with slow 3D drift; a metal-rimmed magnifying glass glides in on an arc, sets down on one small detail and snaps it into focus, the page refracting bigger toward the rim, its shadow and a focused spot of light on the screen below
say: when the speaker points at something small on a screen ('look at the fine print', 'see this number here'): the lens sets down and focuses on the word that names the detail. Set target to the detail in % of the image, zoom 2 to 3
